title: Absolute CSS zero geometry and dynamical realizations: reproducibility code and data
description: Versioned programs, numerical input meshes, interval spectral evidence and original B1-B7 / extended B5 simulation data supporting research on weak compactons and zero-realization effects in an absolute Cooper-Shepard-Sodano Hamiltonian equation. Manuscript files and typeset papers are deliberately excluded. This is a software and data reproducibility deposit; the new B5 numerical runs were executed in a Linux container, not Picasso.
